author: FengForge
description: OFAC / denied-party screening as an MCP server with real fuzzy matching (Levenshtein + fuzzy token alignment, legal-suffix and transliteration normalisation, aliases), a separate embargoed-jurisdiction check (CU/IR/KP/SY + Crimea/DNR/LNR), risk actions, batch screening and hold-memo generation. Ships with a clearly labelled 34-entry SAMPLE dataset plus a fetcher for the full official SDN list.
name: fengforge-ofac-screener
runtime: python3 (>=3.10), zero dependencies, no network at runtime
